{{Quote|The wisest gardener respects the audacity of a stone.|A proverb by Dorak|<ref name="Encyclopedia" />}}
'''''The Collected Writings of Master Dorak''''' was a collection of proverbs and texts written by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dorak]] during his lifetime. It was included in a list of suggested texts for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] to peruse during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], three [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] after Dorak's [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
''The Collected Writings'' were first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> as a reference to Dorak's tendency to speak proverbs in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>
